title: Enforce the declared MSRV recency window
description:
CI proves the workspace on its exact declared compiler and exposes one tested recency command that the protected tag-authorizer can run immediately before tag creation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Workspace rust-version remains 1.97 unless the pre-tag stable comparison requires a refresh, and every Rust crate inherits that single declaration.
- [hard] REQ-02: After the serialized shutdown dependency has committed its final Cargo.lock, the exact-MSRV job derives its compiler from cargo metadata and builds/tests the combined workspace—including axum-server/tokio-util—with that compiler.
- [hard] REQ-03: A deterministic command derives stable at run time, emits machine-readable declared/stable versions plus its own script digest, and fails when declared minor is newer than stable or stable_minor minus declared_minor exceeds one, with unit fixtures for current, one-behind, too-old, and future values.
- [hard] REQ-04: The command is reusable by CI and the protected tag-authorizer; one canonical policy documents derivation and refresh without copying the current stable number into workflow configuration or additional prose.

## Notes

Blast radius: root `Cargo.toml`, the existing MSRV CI job, a focused version-policy script/test, and the canonical release-policy page.
